description: CASEWORK C1 on a run turned 30 degrees about (12, 24) at a typed position: the notched sides on a datum plane turned about Z and offset along the run, every other panel a turned plan rectangle. Locks the angled placement: C1's volume, area, mass and topology, its centroids turned. model.json is the plugin's expansion with the member materials documents applies; members.json each body's member metadata (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_cabinets.py pins both).
derivation: Every expectation is ANALYTIC, from services/geometry/tests/test_casework.py's independent script of casework.md's conventions (spec(), C1 typed from its table), never from the plugin: each panel a box, a notched side its box less its 3 x 4.5 toe notch; summed in exact rational arithmetic (x 25.4 = mm exactly).

C1's numbers; the centroid and centre of mass are C1's turned 30 degrees and moved to (12, 24) in; the plan box is the extremes of every panel's turned plan corners (cos 30, sin 30 in double precision).
surface_area = each panel's box area, a notched side's less twice its notch's face; bodies are separate.
topology: a box 6 faces, 12 edges, 1 shell; a notched side 8 faces, 18 edges. MESH: a box 24 vertices and 12 triangles, a notched side 36 and 20 (two hexagons of 4 triangles, six quads of 2).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), 2026-10-23: volume 3.0e-8 mm^3 off C1's exact sum, centroid 4.6e-13 mm and the plan box 2.3e-13 mm off the turned corners (cos 30 and sin 30 in double precision; the plan points are not rounded); 1e-7 is 3.4x the worst.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-23: the STEP round trip moves the VOLUME by 1.05e-4 mm^3 and the AREA by 4.9e-7 mm^2 (1.8e-12 relative) against 7.5e-9 for the same box at 0 deg: OCCT's STEP drift on turned planes, as plugin-wall-v1-144-30deg's (6.1e-4, a plain build123d twin the same). 5e-4 is 4.8x; volume and area only, centroid and bounds keep ROUNDTRIP_TOL.
